```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, os, subprocess, sys, urllib.error, urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/ninawork/entire/migrate-v2")
ORGS = ["entirehq", "entireio"]
BRANCH = "codex/dual-write-checkpoints-v2-20260428"
TITLE = "Dual write to checkpoints v1 and v2"
BODY = "This is a settings update to dual-write to checkpoints v1 and v2 as part of the checkpoints v2 migration plan. Please see the RFD in https://github.com/entirehq/company-knowledge/pull/51 for more details."

CHECKPOINT_REFS = [
    "refs/heads/entire/checkpoints/v1",
    "refs/heads/entire/checkpoints/v2/main",
    "refs/heads/entire/checkpoints/v2/full",
    "refs/entire/checkpoints/v2/main",
    "refs/entire/checkpoints/v2/full",
]

def sh(args, cwd=None, check=True):
    print("+", " ".join(args), file=sys.stderr)
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, text=True, capture_output=True, check=check)

def token():
    if os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN"):
        return os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "credential", "fill"],
        input="protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n\n",
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
    )
    for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("password="):
            return line.removeprefix("password=")
    raise RuntimeError("no GitHub token from credential helper")

TOKEN = token()

def gh(method, path, data=None):
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.github.com" + path, method=method)
    req.add_header("Authorization", f"Bearer {TOKEN}")
    req.add_header("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
    if data is not None:
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        data = json.dumps(data).encode()
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, data=data) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read() or b"{}")

def list_repos():
    repos = []
    for org in ORGS:
        page = 1
        while True:
            batch = gh("GET", f"/orgs/{org}/repos?type=private&per_page=100&page={page}")
            if not batch:
                break
            repos.extend(batch)
            page += 1
    return repos

def has_checkpoint_ref(repo):
    out = sh(["git", "ls-remote", "--refs", repo["clone_url"], *CHECKPOINT_REFS], check=False)
    return out.returncode == 0 and bool(out.stdout.strip())

def already_v2(settings):
    opts = settings.get("strategy_options") or {}
    return (
        settings.get("checkpoints_version") == "2"
        or (opts.get("checkpoints_v2") is True and opts.get("push_v2_refs") is True)
    )

ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=3)

candidates = []
for repo in list_repos():
    pushed_at = datetime.fromisoformat(repo["pushed_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    if repo["private"] and pushed_at <= cutoff and has_checkpoint_ref(repo):
        candidates.append({
            "full_name": repo["full_name"],
            "name": repo["name"],
            "clone_url": repo["clone_url"],
            "default_branch": repo["default_branch"],
            "pushed_at": repo["pushed_at"],
            "private": repo["private"],
        })

Path("/private/tmp/migrate-v2-candidates.json").write_text(json.dumps(candidates, indent=2) + "\n")

updated = []
status = []
for repo in candidates:
    path = ROOT / repo["name"]
    if not path.exists():
        sh(["git", "clone", repo["clone_url"], str(path)])

    settings_path = path / ".entire" / "settings.json"
    if not settings_path.exists():
        status.append({**repo, "status": "skipped", "reason": "no .entire/settings.json"})
        continue

    try:
        settings = json.loads(settings_path.read_text())
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        status.append({**repo, "status": "skipped", "reason": f"malformed JSON: {e}"})
        continue

    if already_v2(settings):
        status.append({**repo, "status": "skipped", "reason": "already v2"})
        continue

    opts = settings.get("strategy_options") or {}
    opts["checkpoints_v2"] = True
    opts["push_v2_refs"] = True
    settings["strategy_options"] = opts
    settings_path.write_text(json.dumps(settings, indent=2) + "\n")

    sh(["git", "switch", "-c", BRANCH], cwd=path)
    sh(["git", "add", ".entire/settings.json"], cwd=path)
    sh(["git", "commit", "-m", "Enable checkpoints v2 dual-write"], cwd=path)
    sh(["git", "push", "-u", "origin", BRANCH], cwd=path)

    updated.append(repo["full_name"])
    status.append({**repo, "status": "updated"})

Path("/private/tmp/migrate-v2-settings-status.json").write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2) + "\n")
Path("/private/tmp/migrate-v2-updated-repos.json").write_text(json.dumps(updated, indent=2) + "\n")

prs = []
for full_name in updated:
    repo = next(r for r in candidates if r["full_name"] == full_name)
    pr = gh("POST", f"/repos/{full_name}/pulls", {
        "title": TITLE,
        "body": BODY,
        "head": BRANCH,
        "base": repo["default_branch"],
        "draft": False,
    })
    prs.append({
        "full_name": full_name,
        "branch": BRANCH,
        "base": repo["default_branch"],
        "number": pr["number"],
        "url": pr["html_url"],
    })

Path("/private/tmp/migrate-v2-prs.json").write_text(json.dumps(prs, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(prs, indent=2))
```
